analysis: SFMC-REQ-005 defines explicit software behavior required of the SFMC when Autopilot mode is active. It specifies the operational condition ('When Autopilot mode is enabled') and the system response ('the SFMC shall control the spacecraft propulsion system to follow the selected route'). The requirement contains clear allocation to the SFMC, contains no vague language or escape clauses, and uses established terms defined in §1.3, §2.3, and §3.1.
summary: SFMC-REQ-005 clearly specifies the SFMC software obligation to control spacecraft propulsion along a selected route when Autopilot mode is enabled. It has no ambiguous terms or writing defects.
